findings.title: Include the organization in the attribute cache key
findings.body: The new React Query key contains only query options and omits the organization, although the fetch uses an organization-specific endpoint. Switching between organizations with the same date range, dataset, attribute type and project selection (especially the all-projects selection) reuses the same cache entry. This can show one organization's custom attribute names in another organization and lets concurrent consumers overwrite each other's results. Include the organization slug or endpoint path in the key.

findings.title: Pass actual results to the feature-gated table visualization
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, every dashboard table is rendered with an empty columns array and hard-coded empty data and metadata, ignoring the fetched `result`. Consequently, enabling the feature makes populated table widgets appear empty. Adapt the actual result and fields to the new component, or leave this branch disconnected until that adapter is implemented.

findings.title: Normalize error and recording timestamps before merging
findings.body: Error timestamps loaded from nodestore are Unix seconds, whereas replay recording (rrweb) event timestamps are Unix milliseconds. Comparing these raw values causes all errors to be emitted before the first real recording event instead of at their chronological positions. The generated error messages also use seconds while breadcrumb messages use recording timestamps, giving Seer inconsistent time coordinates. Normalize both sources to the same unit before comparison and log generation; the added tests use seconds for recording events and therefore miss this production case.
